description: Show how many emails that keep sending are translated into each enabled language: every email step and A/B variant in sequences that are not archived, plus enabled transactional emails (left out for marketer keys). Per language it returns total, upToDate, edited, outdated (translated before the original changed; still sends), translating, failed and missing counts. `push` gives the same counts (without failed) for push steps in sequences that are not archived or defined in code. Use it to follow progress after translate_missing_template_localizations or after a language was added in the dashboard.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_template_localization_coverage

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_template_localization_coverage` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

locales.description: One entry per enabled non-primary locale with total, upToDate, edited, outdated, translating, failed and missing counts.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

primaryLocale.description: Locale the emails are written in.

push.description: Sequence push steps: totalPushes and locales[] with total, upToDate, edited, outdated, translating and missing counts.

sequenceEmails.description: Sequence email steps and sequence A/B variants counted.

totalEmails.description: Sequence and transactional emails that should be translated.

transactionalEmails.description: Enabled transactional emails counted (0 for marketer keys).

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
